name: Pigeonhole Subset Disguise
description: Replace the explicit exact-cover constraint ("uses 1..k exactly once") with a collision-free constraint ("no two items share an ID"). By the Pigeonhole Principle, selecting k items from a domain of size k with no collisions forces an exact cover. This primes models to formulate the problem as an Independent Set or naive subset search (which TLEs for large t) rather than leveraging the dimension-wise exact cover structure (DLX/backtracking), testing their ability to deduce the underlying search space reduction themselves.
